root_cause.text: The mvpp2 driver’s mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers() path unconditionally performed CM3-based TX flow-control updates via mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc() without checking priv->global_tx_fc, allowing dereference of a NULL priv->cm3_base when the CM3 SRAM resource was absent.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both calls in mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers() from `if (change_percpu)` to `if (change_percpu && priv->global_tx_fc)`, and the CVE/commit message states mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc() accesses CM3 registers through mvpp2_cm3_read()/mvpp2_cm3_write() with no NULL check while `priv->cm3_base` remains NULL if the third DT `reg` entry is missing, causing the shown NULL pointer dereference.

intent_record.intent_summary: Guard private flow-control pool updates during buffer switching so they only occur when global TX flow control is enabled.
intent_record.what: The condition guarding the call to mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, false) was changed from `if (change_percpu)` to `if (change_percpu && priv->global_tx_fc)` inside `mvpp2_bm_switch_buffers()`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the private flow-control buffer pool update is now performed only when both a per-CPU mode change is occurring and global TX flow control is enabled, preventing this update from running in cases where `change_percpu` is true but `priv->global_tx_fc` is false.

intent_record.intent_summary: Guard private flow-control pool updates so they run only during per-CPU buffer changes when global TX flow control is enabled.
intent_record.what: The condition guarding the call to mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc(priv, true) was changed from checking only change_percpu to checking both change_percpu and priv->global_tx_fc.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the private flow-control buffer pool update now occurs only when a per-CPU buffer mode change happens and global TX flow control is enabled, preventing this update from running in cases where global TX flow control is disabled.

grouping_result.intent: Guard private flow-control pool updates so they run only during per-CPU buffer changes when global TX flow control is enabled.

consistency_review.core_intent: Guard private flow-control pool updates so they occur only during per-CPU buffer switching when global TX flow control is enabled.

relevance_review.reason: The changes add the missing guard around private flow-control pool updates in the buffer-switching path, ensuring CM3-based updates only happen when global TX flow control is enabled. This directly addresses the root cause of calling mvpp2_bm_pool_update_priv_fc() without checking priv->global_tx_fc and risking a NULL priv->cm3_base dereference.

candidates.rationale: This call unconditionally performs the CM3-based private flow-control update during buffer switching whenever change_percpu is true, without checking priv->global_tx_fc. That can reach code dereferencing priv->cm3_base even when the CM3 SRAM resource is absent.

This matching re-enable call is also executed based only on change_percpu, not on priv->global_tx_fc, so it can likewise invoke CM3-dependent flow-control logic and trigger a NULL priv->cm3_base dereference.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally invokes the CM3-based private flow-control update during buffer switching without checking priv->global_tx_fc. If the CM3 SRAM resource is absent, the called path can dereference NULL priv->cm3_base, matching the root cause.

This matching re-enable update is also executed without validating priv->global_tx_fc, so it can reach CM3-dependent logic and trigger the same NULL priv->cm3_base dereference when the CM3 SRAM resource is unavailable.
